skill.name: pipedrive-lead-enrich
skill.description: Use Leadsets to find job titles, work emails, and company details for Pipedrive leads. Save results with email status, source, and checked dates.
skill.summary: Fill missing Pipedrive lead details and flag conflicts for review.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The static alerts match Markdown formatting, declared vendor links, and CRM guidance. No evidence of shell execution, environment access, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection was found. The workflow can send CRM identifiers to Leadsets without a separate approval step, and its bulk matching and catch-all defaults can reduce CRM data quality.

remediation.issue: No explicit approval step before sending CRM identifiers to Leadsets.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, selected leads, and fields to be shared before the first enrichment call. Require explicit approval and send only the identifiers needed for each lookup.

remediation.issue: A successful sample does not establish every match in the batch.
remediation.suggestion: Check each result against a known profile URL or matching identity and employer information. Skip writes and add ambiguous matches to the review list.

remediation.issue: Catch-all addresses can populate primary email fields.
remediation.suggestion: Default to writing only verified addresses to primary email fields. Keep catch-all results in a review note and clarify that enrichment can return non-verified statuses.

semantic_findings.title: CRM Identifiers Shared Without a Separate Approval Step
semantic_findings.description: The default run can send a profile URL or a name and company domain from Pipedrive to Leadsets without a separate approval step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow specifies the CRM inputs and first external lookup, but it does not require approval before sending them. The vendor is disclosed.

semantic_findings.title: Batch Updates Lack a Per-Person Identity Check
semantic_findings.description: The workflow verifies one sample before running the batch. Later results can reach CRM writeback without a required identity check for each person.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sample requires a person match. Later steps retain confidence and check employer changes, but do not require a per-person identity match before writing.

semantic_findings.title: Catch-All Addresses Enter CRM Email Fields by Default
semantic_findings.description: A catch-all result does not establish that a mailbox exists. The default still writes it as a lead email, where downstream tools may ignore its status.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The default explicitly writes catch-all addresses and can store status in a note. Whether downstream tools honor the label is not established.

content.value_statement: New Pipedrive leads often arrive without work emails, job titles, or company details. Use Leadsets to fill missing fields and flag conflicting values for review.
actual_capabilities: Select Pipedrive leads by filter, view, label, or date range.
Check remaining Leadsets records and test a single person match before processing the batch.
Find current roles and work emails with verification status through Leadsets.
Look up industry, headcount range, and location once per unique company domain.
Update mapped person and organization fields, add source and checked dates, and preserve existing values by default.
Summarize outcomes, flag conflicts and possible job changes, and export the results as CSV on request.
limitations: Requires a Pipedrive connection with write access and either Leadsets MCP access or a Leadsets API key.
Leadsets quotas can interrupt a batch, and an enrichment lookup may return no match.
Catch-all addresses are not verified. Unknown and invalid addresses are not saved as contact emails.
Does not find phone numbers, send emails, or add leads to outreach sequences.

use_cases.title: Complete inbound lead records
use_cases.description: Fill missing titles and work emails on recent leads before handing them to sales.

use_cases.title: Standardize company fields
use_cases.description: Add industry, headcount range, and location to organizations linked to a filtered lead list.

use_cases.title: Review event leads after import
use_cases.description: Enrich an event lead list and review employer changes or conflicting values before assigning follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Fill missing details on recent leads
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich Pipedrive leads added in the last seven days. Fill missing titles and save only verified work emails. Keep existing values and list conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich companies in a saved view
prompt_templates.scenario: Your team needs consistent organization details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Pipedrive view [view name]. Fill missing industry, headcount range, and location on linked organizations. Look up each company domain once.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich leads with custom field mapping
prompt_templates.scenario: Your workspace tracks verification status in custom fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich leads with the label [label]. Use [status field] and [checked date field] for email verification details. Keep catch-all addresses out of contact email fields.

prompt_templates.title: Run a quota-aware batch
prompt_templates.scenario: The selected lead list may exceed the remaining Leadsets quota.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich Pipedrive leads created between [start date] and [end date]. Test one match and process only what fits the current allowance. Export a CSV and report deferred leads, reset times, and conflicts.

output_examples.input: Fill missing titles and verified work emails for this week's 12 inbound leads. Keep existing values.
output: Nine leads updated, two had no match, and one needs review for a possible job change.
Seven verified work emails were saved. No existing values were overwritten.

output_examples.input: Update company details for the event lead view. Report what remains after the quota is reached.
output: Industry and headcount were added for five organizations. Each organization domain was looked up once.
Three organization lookups remain. The current quota window resets at 14:00 UTC.

best_practices: Confirm that your organization allows sharing lead identifiers with Leadsets before starting.
Use a narrow lead selection and compare the first match with the Pipedrive record before continuing.
Save only verified work emails to the contact email field and review employer changes before approving updates.
anti_patterns: Marking a catch-all, unknown, or previously saved email as verified without a verified Leadsets result.
Replacing rep-entered values without explicit permission.
Running a broad batch without checking the Leadsets quota and the first match.

faq.question: What connections do I need?
faq.answer: Connect Pipedrive for reads and writes. Connect the Leadsets MCP server or configure a Leadsets API key for enrichment.

faq.question: Which leads are selected by default?
faq.answer: The default selects leads created in the last seven days that are missing an email, job title, or organization details.

faq.question: Will this overwrite existing CRM values?
faq.answer: No. The default fills empty fields and lists conflicts and possible job changes for review.

faq.question: How are catch-all emails handled?
faq.answer: The default saves them with a separate catch-all status. Ask to save only verified addresses to keep catch-all addresses out of contact email fields.

faq.question: What does Leadsets receive?
faq.answer: A person lookup can use a profile URL or a name with a company domain. Company enrichment uses organization domains.

faq.question: What happens when the quota is reached?
faq.answer: The run reports remaining work and the reset time when available. If free records are exhausted, it stops and asks about upgrading.
